prose: Mithrl, an AI infrastructure company for biopharma, raised a $20 million Series A led by Obvious Ventures, CEO Vivek Adarsh told Axios exclusively. The company integrates its proprietary biomedical world model with the R&D systems of pharmaceutical companies.
highlights: Mithrl raised a $20M Series A led by Obvious Ventures.
Its biomedical world model integrates with pharma companies' R&D systems.
The raise was disclosed by CEO Vivek Adarsh to Axios.
